mostWorthwhile.text: Publishing the manually sourced door status was the most worthwhile passage: it brought the two entry demonstrations together with an honest account of what was known.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the sensor to the latch was confusing: the attempt instead produced an unknown-state display, so I had to revise my expectation.

surprise.text: The disconnected sensor led to an explicit unknown reading, followed by a separate manual observation rather than a fictional sensor repair.

arbitrary.text: The status display's required combination with the opened door was not obvious to me; I had guessed it should go straight to the controller.

continue.text: Yes. The combination of practical fallback mechanisms and careful reporting of uncertain information makes me curious to see what the neighborhood builds next.
